state:
**Side goal `website-overhaul`, stage 4 (Syntax) is in progress. These pages are written: "Start here", the Basics, "Values and types", Operators, Control flow, Errors and Functions.**

`tools/nv/cmd/site.ts` `syntaxProblems` is the `syntax` part, tested in `tools/nv/test/site.test.ts`. Every Syntax page except `syntax/index.mdx` needs a non-empty `covers:`, a `<Snippet>` and a `## Do and don't` list.

On disk: `website/src/content/docs/syntax/start-here.mdx`, `syntax/basics/*.mdx`, `syntax/values/*.mdx`, `syntax/operators/*.mdx`, `syntax/control-flow/*.mdx`, `syntax/errors/*.mdx` and `syntax/functions/{declaring,parameters,calls,closures}.mdx`. Snippets sit flat under `website/snippets/syntax/<page>/`, with no section level, and must exit 0 when run from the repo root. Sidebar entries are in `website/astro.config.ts`, and stamps are in `website/site.lock.json` (`bun nv site --stamp syntax/<group>/<page>.mdx ...`, with the `.mdx`). A front-matter value with `: ` in it must be quoted, or `covers:` reads as missing. A class id with backslashes goes in single quotes: `'Core\Db\DbError'`.

Novis has no free functions and no user generics, so the Functions pages teach static methods and leave generics out. `site structure`, `stale` and `reference` pass. `site syntax` reports 53 uncovered features: Classes (17 ids, including `Comparable`, `Stringable`, `Parses`, `PropertyObserver`, `lang:types/callable-classes-object-shapes`, `lang:types/properties-and-constants`, `lang:expressions/object-literals`, `lang:expressions/is-new-clone-throw-print-exit-isset-empty`), `lang:programs/*` (5), `lang:concurrency/*` (10), `lang:attributes/*` (9) and `lang:testing/*` (7). `snippets` and `prose` fail only on `index.mdx`, `install/*`, `sponsoring.mdx` and `in-depth/what-changed.mdx`, which stages 5 and 6 rewrite.
